name: Paralysis
overview: The Bible reveals that paralysis, often described as 'palsy,' was among the many afflictions miraculously healed through the power of Jesus and His apostles. Jesus demonstrated His authority not only by healing the paralyzed but also by forgiving sins, affirming His divine power on earth (Matthew 9:2, 9:6). This healing extended beyond Jesus to His followers, as Philip and Peter also healed those suffering from palsies and other infirmities, confirming the ongoing work of the Spirit in the early church (Acts 8:7). These accounts emphasize the compassionate and sovereign power of Christ to restore physical and spiritual wholeness.
